boundary: Official issuer disclosures are direct evidence of what the company reported to the market. Forward-looking statements, estimates and company characterisations are not independent verification.

items.headline: Blacksmith Project Mineral Resource and Ore Reserve Update
items.summary: Fortescue lodged an updated resource and reserve statement for Blacksmith, a proposed Pilbara project that the company says could support more than 20 years of operation and around 5Mtpa of direct-shipping ore.
items.relevance: A potential new Pilbara production source and future workforce footprint; project timing and execution remain subject to company decisions and approvals.

items.headline: FY26 Full Year Results
items.summary: Fortescue reported record FY26 iron ore shipments of 201.3Mt, underlying net profit after tax of about US$3.5 billion and a total FY26 dividend of A$1.08 per share.
items.relevance: The results frame operating scale, cost capacity and capital available for Pilbara operations, Iron Bridge and decarbonisation investment.

items.headline: BHP FY2026 Results Announcement
items.summary: BHP reported record WAIO production and shipments and announced Ministers North, a proposed Pilbara mine intended to help sustain WAIO production above 305Mtpa.
items.relevance: Direct evidence of BHP's Pilbara production and replacement-mine strategy, separate from the active Port Operations bargaining matter.

items.headline: June 2026 Quarterly Report
items.summary: South32 reported Worsley Alumina FY26 saleable production of 3.722Mt, broadly unchanged year on year, with FY27 guidance maintained at 3.9Mt.
items.relevance: Official operating context for the Worsley bargaining campaign. The disclosure does not establish the status or effect of bargaining.

items.headline: Rio Tinto 2026 Half Year Results
items.summary: Rio Tinto reported a 28% increase in underlying EBITDA and a 75% increase in free cash flow, alongside continued productivity improvement across the portfolio.
items.relevance: Financial and capital-allocation context for Rio's Pilbara replacement mines, Rhodes Ridge studies and workforce investment.

items.headline: Quarterly Activity Report — Q4 FY26
items.summary: MinRes reported FY26 Onslow Iron attributable shipments of 19.7Mt above upgraded guidance, Pilbara Hub shipments of 9.9Mt, and stronger liquidity with net debt reduced to about A$4.3 billion.
items.relevance: Direct operating and balance-sheet context for Onslow Iron, the Pilbara Hub and the Port of Ashburton supply chain.

items.headline: Second Quarter 2026 Production Results
items.summary: Rio Tinto reported Q2 Pilbara production of 83.5Mt and sales of 85.3Mt on a 100% basis, with first-half Pilbara production up 6% year on year.
items.relevance: Source-linked operating context for Rio's Pilbara system and a baseline against which later workforce or disruption claims can be tested.
